_meta.description: Per-category, per-word quiz questions for QUIZ mode. Two questions per word, each a different type. Age target: 5–8. Varied types (colour, sound, size, where, action, fact, number, yes_no, either_or) so children stay engaged. The agent asks the EXACT question from live state; any child answer is accepted — the host reacts warmly, never says 'wrong'.
